title: The task end retries-exhausted omits a last not-started attempt after the automatic retries are spent
resolution: Fixed: retries-exhausted covers a not-started outcome or a known failing exit after a proven start once MAX_AUTOMATIC_RETRIES are spent; delta scenario and required test added; design D6.

title: The fleet obstacle applies without checking that the task waits for placement, so a cancelled or rejected task could show no-candidate
resolution: Fixed: contract section 3.8 decides applicability first; only a task that waits for placement (G2 placementNeed) has a waiting obstacle, so a rejection is never hidden by the fleet read; delta scenario and design D5.

title: The automatic retry obstacle has no checkable backing-off criterion and hides a newer scheduler record
resolution: Fixed: the retry, the worker refusal, and the scheduler's waiting record compete by observedAt, the scheduler's on a tie; the due time is in memory only, so a later try's newer record wins; delta scenario and design D5.

title: An older worker refusal hides a newer scheduler outcome that created no assignment
resolution: Fixed: the most recent observation by observedAt wins between refusal, retry, and scheduler record (contract section 3.8); delta scenario and required test.

title: A rejected record stays shown after a re-admission until a new attempt opens
resolution: Fixed: a rejected obstacle and a task end hold only at the ownership generation the attempt ended in, so rebindAdmission hides them at once; delta scenario and design D5, D6.

title: The last stage of the topological order need not be the Close stage, since the SDLC parser requires no terminal closure stage
resolution: Fixed: the Close stage is the last stage with the closure obligation in graph order, which every admissible graph has because the parser requires every obligation covered; no parser constraint added (design D3); delta scenario and required test.

title: The completed workflow requirement moves the card to a restarted stage unconditionally, and the living board columns requirement still defines the current stage only as the first not completed
resolution: Fixed: the requirement adds the first-not-completed condition, and a MODIFIED Board columns from the framework mapping adds the closure fallback (491 characters).

title: The automatic-retry obstacle variant carries no reason although every obstacle has one
resolution: Fixed: the variant carries reason RETRY_BACKOFF_REASON (retry-backoff), exported and covered by a value test; contract section 3.8 names it.

title: The common rule says every query and command names one project, against the installation-scoped inbox
resolution: Fixed: section 2.1 excepts the installation-scoped inbox and checks the installation-owner role for it.

title: The port table omits the reconciliation source of the NeedsYouSource port
resolution: Fixed: the table names the reconciliation source over the G2 ReconciliationQueue; pass 2 N9 completed it with G3 plan item 44.

title: The task detail sentence has a doubled comma
resolution: Fixed: the sentence reads for the card of that run and for each stage.

title: Waiting for placement ignores a held reservation, so a placed task not yet launched could show a fleet obstacle
resolution: Fixed: waiting also requires that the active attempt has no assignment with a held reservation, as both placement queue adapters read it; delta scenario Placed, not yet launched; required test; design D5.

title: The project's current policy revision is undefined, and the auto-merge rule at one revision leaves pushes of runs at another revision waiting, against the auto-merge-authority scenario
resolution: Fixed within D8: the project's current policy revision is the one new runs bind to; the auto-merge rule exists at every revision current for an unclosed run, recorded on turning auto-merge on and by a new revision's writer; delta scenario; required test.

title: The re-queue at the same head has no requirement scenario and no required test
resolution: Fixed: delta scenarios Re-queue at the same head and Chosen withdrawal at the same head, and the merge gate required test covers both; design D4.

title: Every stage before the Close stage is ambiguous once the Close stage need not be last
resolution: Fixed: pre-merge stages are every stage other than the Close stage and the stages depending on it; delta requirement and scenario Stage after the closure stage in graph order; required test; design D4.

title: The merge queue comment omits the re-queue exception to idempotent enqueueing
resolution: Fixed: the comment names the re-queue of section 6.3 within two lines of 80 characters.

title: A waiting scheduler record is not checked against the active attempt, so a record of an earlier attempt could be shown
resolution: Fixed: a waiting record counts only when it names the active attempt, or none while the task has no attempt; delta scenario Record of an earlier attempt; required test.

title: The contract uses task for the card in several places, against its own vocabulary
resolution: Fixed: card or the card's change at the port table, intake, write-back, merge gate, standing rule scope, and conflict flow text.

title: TaskView.runId means the task's own run while runId elsewhere is the card's key
resolution: Fixed: renamed to taskRunId with a comment; the contract's section 3.7 names it.

title: The reconciliation source is called unassigned although G3 plan item 44 covers it
resolution: Fixed: the port table cites item 44 implement-readmission-and-reconciliation-surface of the G3 work plan; verification.md no longer calls it unassigned.

title: The admission's ownership generation is ambiguous and the task view lacks the task's current generation
resolution: Fixed: AdmissionView.dispatchedGeneration is the generation the dispatch started, TaskView.ownershipGeneration the task's current one; contract section 3.7 and design D2.

title: A clean exit without a proven start is not classified
resolution: Fixed: a clean exit is exit code 0 after a proven start; without a proven start it is uncertain-exit; delta requirement and design D6.

title: The recorded citation check omits the citations added by the pass 1 fixes
resolution: Fixed: the citation list adds the pass 1 and pass 2 citations with the revision they were checked at.

title: Two citations point at doc comments instead of the declarations
resolution: Fixed: stage-progress.ts:39 and worker-revocation.ts:10.
